title: Mosy's Elemental amulets
description: This mod adds elemental powers, each with different abilities and mechanics.
body:
This mod adds elemental amulets which give you specific powers, you can choose your favourite at the start of the game. Here's a list of all the current amulets:
- Earth amulet: Grow grass where you walk. Press R to summon powerful spikes from the ground.
- Fire amulet: You are immune to fire. Press R to launch explosive fireballs.
- Air amulet: You are immune to fall DMG and can double-jump. Press R to launch yourself and blast enemies away.
- Thunder amulet: Look at a target and press R to strike a lighting at their location. You can activate redstone-related blocks (Pistons, iron doors, etc) just with your touch.
- Water amulet: Look at a water source and press R to use a small amount of water as your own flying carpet, press R again to stop flying. You are granted with water breathing.

If you regret choosing a power, you can always craft an _Absolute_ _amulet_ with your current amulet, 2 amethyst clusters and 2 diamonds. Once crafted, right-click and switch your elemental power.
